conf.description: ArcSight SmartConnectors connector-audit / csv-file: header-keyed CSV parse of the ArcSight CSV File destination's rotating audit file, text-to-type coercion for timestamps/severity/type/count, the same signature-ID event.outcome lookup and agent:049 label-keyed parser-slot resolution as the avro-kafka pipeline, then rename to ECS/custom.

conf.comment: arcsight-connectors / connector-audit / csv-file. Columns are operator-selected in the destination's column picker, so the exact set/order is a deployment choice this map cannot fix; the serde fields list below ASSUMES every documented column is selected in the map's own listed order, interleaving each deviceCustomStringN with its paired Label. Adjust the fields array to match the deployed column picker. event.outcome uses the EXACT lookup from recommendations.direct.cribl: success={030,016,020,101,025}, failure={015,028,029,042,102,103,104,105,008,011,026}. Timestamps arrive as text (unlike the Avro path) and are coerced with Date.parse; a connector emitting a non-Date.parse-compatible locale format needs this adjusted. Order: csv parse -> label resolution -> eval (from ORIGINAL names) -> batched rename.
